text:
After the WHCD shooting, the White House called on Democrats to stop the violent rhetoric. 

Many Democrats pushed back saying to also call out the President’s and Republicans rhetoric too. 

Here the President is calling Jeffries a “danger” to our country.

许多民主党人反驳说，也要谴责总统和共和党的言论。 

总统在这里称杰弗里斯对我们国家来说是“危险”。

text:
Pres. Trump on stage complaining about Congress saying "you only have three days left" for the war in Iran. "What's taking so long?" he says as he mocks members of Congress questioning his war in Iran.

"If left right now it would take them 20-25 years to the rebuild the place."
translated_text:
新闻。特朗普在台上抱怨国会说伊朗战争“只剩三天了”。 “什么事要花这么长时间？”他一边嘲笑国会议员质疑他在伊朗的战争，一边说道。

“如果现在离开，他们将需要 20 到 25 年才能重建这个地方。”

text:
President Trump on stage for the "Forum Club of the Palm Beaches Dinner" inside the Raymond F. Kravis Center for the Performing Arts in Palm Beach, Florida.

This is his first big day of public outings since the shooting at the White House Correspondent's dinner last weekend.

这是自上周末白宫记者晚宴发生枪击事件以来他首次公开露面。

text:
The protestor on top of the Frederick Douglass Memorial Bridge in Washington, D.C. is protesting the war in Iran, he says on X. 

He also warns of the dangers of AI.

He seems to be posting while on top of the bridge.
translated_text:

他还警告人工智能的危险。

他似乎是在桥顶上发帖的。
